description: A Streamlit-based chatbot application integrating OpenAI and Google Generative AI models to generate SQL queries and answers based on a school database. It includes functions for prompt generation, model interaction, data retrieval, and cost calculation.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining user question and additional context for model input.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI's chat completion API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and returns fetched rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a detailed prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response parts.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates total token-based cost for query and answer outputs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function managing user interaction, model calls, data retrieval, and response display.
